study_card.main_practice: 跟读 + 精读 + 中文讲解对照
study_card.suggested_pace: 先猜大意 · 再听读 · 最后完成英文输出

segments.en: This week I opened a notebook and used variables. I made a small function and tested it. I put values in a list and read a JSON file. These actions are small, but they are the basic steps of a useful program.
segments.tts: This week I opened a notebook and used variables. I made a small function and tested it. I put values in a list and read a JSON file. These actions are small, but they are the basic steps of a useful program.
segments.zh: 这周我打开了 notebook，使用了变量。我写了一个小函数并测试它，把值放进列表，还读取了 JSON 文件。这些动作很小，却是实用程序的基础步骤。讲解：basic=基础的，action=动作，useful=有用的。

segments.en: I also learned how to debug. When an error appears, I read the message and check one thing at a time. I do not need to understand everything at once. I only need the next clear step.
segments.tts: I also learned how to debug. When an error appears, I read the message and check one thing at a time. I do not need to understand everything at once. I only need the next clear step.
segments.zh: 我还学会了怎样调试。出现错误时，我读信息，一次检查一件事。我不需要一下子理解所有内容，只需要找到下一步清楚的动作。讲解：at once=一下子，next step=下一步，clear=清楚的。

segments.en: For next week, I will use Python with a small table of real data. I will read it, clean it, and ask one simple question. Learning works when I practice a little every day.
segments.tts: For next week, I will use Python with a small table of real data. I will read it, clean it, and ask one simple question. Learning works when I practice a little every day.
segments.zh: 下周我会用 Python 处理一张真实数据小表。我会读取、清理数据，再问一个简单问题。每天练习一点，学习就会有效果。讲解：real data=真实数据，clean data=清理数据，practice=练习。

chunks.eg: Check one thing at a time.
I practice a little every day.

patterns.t: I do not need to X at once.

patterns.cn: 当 X 时，学习会有效果。

transfer_tasks.task: Write a weekly review with three sentences. Use the basic steps, one thing at a time, and practice every day.
